text:
nina: Quick kickoff  we need a compact battlecard + launch post anchored to the new inference benchmark. Audience: platform buyers and ML infra teams. Goal: AE-qualified meetings + SDR nurture. Webinar target 2024-09-10.
ralph: Keep hero stat tight: p95 latency delta + steady unit cost. Avoid absolute multipliers. Use conservative language and cite appendix.
zoe: I'll draft the 1-pg battlecard and a short FAQ for AEs. Include a tiny decision flow: hosted -> dedicated -> private and one ROI row example.
carl-sdr: Routing: registrants -> if title contains "Platform" or company_size>=400 -> AE_queue; if role contains "Procurement" -> AE_procurement; else SDR_nurture. EU leads -> EU queue. Need two email templates (invite + replay) and 30s call openers.
deploy-bot: benchmark CSV uploaded: https://storage.redwood/bench/sep2024/serve-vs-cloud.csv
nina: Webinar demo idea: 5m recorded p95 under load + 4m on levers (batching, cache, quantization) and 3 customer-facing takeaways. Clip for SDR outreach.
ralph: Messaging frame: "Serving, not owning 50%+ lower steady-state unit cost (typical workloads) and consistent latency"  but make the claim softer: "~50% lower" and always link appendix.
zoe: I'll add 3 one-line objection handlers for SDRs: 1) "We already use major cloud": "Cloud gives compute; Redwood gives serving economics and safe rollouts." 2) "Lock-in concerns": "Private deploy + clear data exit paths." 3) "Benchmarks look synthetic": "See appendix + replayable demo using customer traces."
carl-sdr: HubSpot pseudo-rule I'll implement:
```
if role contains any ["CTO","Head of ML","Platform"] or company_size >= 400 -> AE_queue
elif role contains "Procurement" or company_size >= 1000 -> AE_procurement
elif lead_score >= 65 -> SDR_priority
else -> nurture_sequence
```
nina: Deliverables & owners: battlecard = zoe; webinar deck + demo script = ralph; emails + SDR playbook = carl-sdr; infra sign-off = product. Check-in 48h.
zoe: Draft links: notion -> https://notion.redwood/marketing/serve-econ/sdrcore-draft. I'll ping product for sign-off after copy pass.
ralph: Tone note: business-first (unit economics + reliability). Keep tech footnotes in appendix only.
carl-sdr: I'll prep AE handoff template that includes tags: #enterprise #gdpr-eu #regulated and required fields for AE (expected QPS, current cost per 1M tokens, private deploy interest).
nina: Nice. Keep claims source-linked. We'll iterate on copy to avoid engineering jargon. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
